import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long rev;
        long capacity;
        long cost;
        long flow;
        public Edge(int to, long rev, long capacity, long cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int n;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        long[] dist;
        long[] potential;
        int[] parent;
        int[] parentEdge;

        public MinCostMaxFlow(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            dist = new long[n];
            potential = new long[n];
            parent = new int[n];
            parentEdge = new int[n];
        }

        public void addEdge(int from, int to, long capacity, long cost) {
            graph.get(from).add(new Edge(to, graph.get(to).size(), capacity, cost));
            graph.get(to).add(new Edge(from, graph.get(from).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
        }

        public long[] minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            long cost = 0;
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                dist[s] = 0;
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] cur = pq.poll();
                    long d = cur[0];
                    int u = (int) cur[1];
                    if (d > dist[u]) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0) {
                            long nd = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                            if (nd < dist[e.to]) {
                                dist[e.to] = nd;
                                parent[e.to] = u;
                                parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                                pq.offer(new long[]{nd, e.to});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == Long.MAX_VALUE) break;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (dist[i] < Long.MAX_VALUE) {
                        potential[i] += dist[i];
                    }
                }
                long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                    Edge e = graph.get[parent[u]].get(parentEdge[u]);
                    for (Edge e2 : graph.get[parent[u]]) {
                        if (e2.to == u && e2.capacity > 0) {
                            df = Math.min(df, e2.capacity);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (int u = t; u != s; u = parent[u]) {
                    Edge e = graph.get[parent[u]].get(parentEdge[u]);
                    for (Edge e2 : graph.get[parent[u]]) {
                        if (e2.to == u && e2.capacity > 0) {
                            e2.capacity -= df;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    for (Edge e2 : graph.get(u)) {
                        if (e2.to == parent[u]) {
                            e2.capacity += df;
                            cost += df * e2.cost;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                flow += df;
            }
            return new long[]{flow, cost};
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int T = 99;
        final long INF = 1L << 60;
        final int C = 12;

        int size = 50 * T + 2;
        MinCostMaxFlow network = new MinCostMaxFlow(size);

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            network.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            network.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    network.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int costVal = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    network.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, costVal * d + c);
                    network.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, costVal * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] result = network.minCostFlow(source, sink);
        long flow_res = result[0];
        long total_price = result[1];

        if (flow_res != k) {
            System.out.println(-1);
        } else {
            System.out.println(total_price);
        }
    }
}
